description: This file defines the 'NoteController' class, a REST controller in a Spring Boot application that manages CRUD operations for 'notes'. It provides endpoints under '/api/notes' for listing, retrieving, creating, updating, deleting, and seeding notes. The class interacts with a 'NoteService' to perform business logic and handles HTTP requests/responses.

classes.name: NoteController
classes.description: REST controller for Notes CRUD API providing endpoints for managing notes

methods.name: toResponse
methods.description: Converts a Note entity to a NoteResponse DTO

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all notes

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a note by its ID

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new note

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing note by ID

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a note by ID

methods.name: seed
methods.description: Handles POST requests to seed sample notes
